purpose: Cutover inventory evidence, refreshed before the first bounded removal. It re-measures the in-tree Cursor surface at the current origin/main baseline, records the host-versus-standalone drift that matters before the in-tree copy is deleted, and re-states the retirement and batch dispositions. This file is additive: it does not replace, edit, or supersede migration-inventory.json, which remains the extraction history at its own baseline commit. Nothing here is read at runtime and it is not a plugin registry, manifest, or dependency lock.
